devdoc.details: This contract implements the liquidity protection mechanism.

AverageRateMaxDeviationUpdated(uint32,ui.details: triggered when the maximum deviation of the average rate from the spot rate is updated

params._newAverageRateMaxDeviation: new maximum deviation of the average rate from the spot rate
params._prevAverageRateMaxDeviation: previous maximum deviation of the average rate from the spot rate

LockDurationUpdated(uint256,uint256).details: triggered when the network token lock duration is updated

params._newLockDuration: new network token lock duration, in seconds
params._prevLockDuration: previous network token lock duration, in seconds

MinNetworkCompensationUpdated(uint256,ui.details: triggered when the minimum network token compensation is updated

ProtectionDelaysUpdated(uint256,uint256,.details: triggered when the protection delays are updated

params._newMinProtectionDelay: new seconds until the protection starts
params._prevMinProtectionDelay: previous seconds until the protection starts

SystemNetworkTokenLimitsUpdated(uint256,.details: triggered when the system network token balance limits are updated

params._newMaxSystemNetworkTokenAmount: new maximum absolute balance in a pool
params._newMaxSystemNetworkTokenRatio: new maximum balance out of the total balance in a pool
params._prevMaxSystemNetworkTokenAmount: previous maximum absolute balance in a pool
params._prevMaxSystemNetworkTokenRatio: previos maximum balance out of the total balance in a pool

WhitelistAdminUpdated(address,address).details: triggered when whitelist admin is updated

acceptOwnership().details: used by a new owner to accept an ownership transfer

acceptStoreOwnership().details: accepts the ownership of the store can only be called by the contract owner

addLiquidity(address,address,uint256).details: adds protected liquidity to a pool also mints new governance tokens for the caller if the caller adds network tokens

params._amount: amount of tokens to add to the pool
params._reserveToken: reserve token to add to the pool

claimBalance(uint256,uint256).details: allows the caller to claim network token balance that is no longer locked note that the function can revert if the range is too large

params._endIndex: end index in the caller's list of locked balances (exclusive)
params._startIndex: start index in the caller's list of locked balances

isPoolSupported(address).details: checks if protection is supported for the given pool only standard pools are supported (2 reserves, 50%/50% weights) note that the pool should still be whitelisted

returns._0: true if the pool is supported, false otherwise

poolROI(address,address,uint256,uint256,.details: returns the ROI for removing liquidity in the current state after providing liquidity with the given args the function assumes full protection is in effect return value is in PPM and can be larger than PPM_RESOLUTION for positive ROI, 1M = 0% ROI

params._poolRateD: rate of 1 pool token in reserve token units when the liquidity was added (denominator)
params._poolRateN: rate of 1 pool token in reserve token units when the liquidity was added (numerator)
params._reserveAmount: reserve token amount that was added
params._reserveRateD: rate of 1 reserve token in the other reserve token units when the liquidity was added (denominator)
params._reserveRateN: rate of 1 reserve token in the other reserve token units when the liquidity was added (numerator)

protectLiquidity(address,uint256).details: adds protection to existing pool tokens also mints new governance tokens for the caller

params._amount: amount of pool tokens to protect

removeLiquidity(uint256,uint32).details: removes protected liquidity from a pool also burns governance tokens from the caller if the caller removes network tokens

params._id: id in the caller's list of protected liquidity
params._portion: portion of liquidity to remove, in PPM

removeLiquidityReturn(uint256,uint32,uin.details: returns the expected/actual amounts the provider will receive for removing liquidity it's also possible to provide the remove liquidity time to get an estimation for the return at that given point

params._portion: portion of liquidity to remove, in PPM
params._removeTimestamp: time at which the liquidity is removed

returns._0: expected return amount in the reserve token
returns._1: actual return amount in the reserve token

restrictRegistryUpdate(bool).details: restricts the permission to update the contract-registry

params._onlyOwnerCanUpdateRegistry: indicates whether or not permission is restricted to owner only

setAverageRateMaxDeviation(uint32).details: sets the maximum deviation of the average rate from the spot rate can only be called by the contract owner

params._averageRateMaxDeviation: maximum deviation of the average rate from the spot rate

setLockDuration(uint256).details: updates the network token lock duration can only be called by the contract owner

params._lockDuration: network token lock duration, in seconds

setMinNetworkCompensation(uint256).details: updates the minimum network token compensation can only be called by the contract owner

setProtectionDelays(uint256,uint256).details: updates the protection delays can only be called by the contract owner

setSystemNetworkTokenLimits(uint256,uint.details: updates the system network token balance limits can only be called by the contract owner

params._maxSystemNetworkTokenAmount: maximum absolute balance in a pool
params._maxSystemNetworkTokenRatio: maximum balance out of the total balance in a pool (in PPM units)

setWhitelistAdmin(address).details: set the address of the whitelist admin can only be called by the contract owner

params._whitelistAdmin: the address of the new whitelist admin

transferLiquidity(uint256,address).details: transfers protected liquidity to a new provider

transferOwnership(address).details: allows transferring the contract ownership the new owner still needs to accept the transfer can only be called by the contract owner

transferStoreOwnership(address).details: transfers the ownership of the store can only be called by the contract owner

params._newOwner: the new owner of the store

unprotectLiquidity(uint256,uint256).details: cancels the protection and returns the pool tokens to the caller also burns governance tokens from the caller must be called with the indices of both the base token and the network token protections

params._id1: id in the caller's list of protected liquidity
params._id2: matching id in the caller's list of protected liquidity

whitelistPool(address,bool).details: adds a pool to the whitelist, or removes a pool from the whitelist note that when a pool is whitelisted, it's not possible to remove liquidity anymore removing a pool from the whitelist is an extreme measure in case of a base token compromise etc. can only be called by the whitelist admin

params._add: true to add the pool to the whitelist, false to remove it from the whitelist
